meta.name: Collision: Is Christianity Good for the World?
meta.description: Renowned political journalist and best-selling author Christopher Hitchens is pitted against fellow author, theologian, and evangelical Christian Douglas Wilson, as they go on the road to exchange debate over the question: Is Christianity Good for the World? The two theologians argue, confide and even laugh together as they journey through three cities presenting the debate. This film documents the journey, bringing the sharp points together to provide a critical analysis of religion and its perpetuation.
